For WebQSP, we use precision, recall, and F1 scores. For MS MARCO, we employ BERTScore, using deberta-xlarge-mnli model to ensure optimal performance, as it provides the highest correlation with human evaluations. Results are reported as the average F1 score across the entire dataset, referred to as BERT-F1. For MAC, we employ the Crosslingual Optimized Metric for Evaluation of Translation (COMET), a neural-based evaluation metric that leverages contextual embeddings from pretrained language models to assess translation quality.
